verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Vue says it 'builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript', a 'Tooling Guide' exists, and the community notes Vue can be dropped into existing server-rendered templates; together these imply output that works with ordinary browser DOM inspection. Nothing in the pack explicitly states that Vue renders real DOM nodes inspectable in devtools, or describes any devtools debugging workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that rendered output is real DOM inspectable in browser devtools, documented devtools debugging guidance (e.g. a Vue devtools extension or component inspection), and hands-on or independent corroboration of the debugging experience.
